## What's changed

- Add individual audio and subtitle include controls to metadata-only edits and propagate choices to matching batch tracks.
- Match subtitle tracks by language and SDH identity, independent of default and forced flags.
- Use cached CUDA/NVDEC for source previews and crop analysis when available, with CPU fallback.
- Keep NVENC hardware decoding enabled when Auto Crop is on.
- Detect hearing-impaired subtitles from SDH description metadata.
